During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a '''battle''' was waged aboard the [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] ''[[Voidstar]]''. The technologically-advanced [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] had gone missing during the [[Great Galactic War]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior, only to be rediscovered during the Cold War by both factions. The now-derelict ship contained the schematics for a prototype [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]&mdash;a prize sought after by both the Republic and the Sith Empire.

An Imperial strike team under the command of [[Dark Council]] member [[Darth Marr]] soon arrived in a [[Gage-class transport|''Gage''-class transport]] and boarded the vessel in an [[Imperial assault shuttle]] to acquire the schematics, but a [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvette]] soon arrived carrying a Republic team led by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]], which boarded the vessel in a [[Rendaran-class assault shuttle|''Rendaran''-class assault shuttle]] and intercepted the Sith Empire's strike team.
